conflicts.fact: Which cell the nucleus is missing from vs. the nucleus's role in the 'shared structures' of cells; whether all cells share a nucleus
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 says plant and animal cells share a cell membrane, cytoplasm and nucleus 'in most cases'. Lessons 5 and 8 list the universal features as membrane, cytoplasm, ribosomes and DNA. Lesson 7 lists only membrane, cytoplasm and genetic material, omitting ribosomes. The shared feature set is inconsistent.

conflicts.fact: Structure of the cumulative cell model carried from Lesson 4 to Lesson 5
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 builds two separate 2D labelled diagrams, one plant cell and one animal cell. Lesson 5 says students retrieve a three-column comparison chart (Generic Eukaryotic | Animal Specialised | Plant Specialised) from Lesson 4 and add a fourth column.

conflicts.fact: Which organelles are found in animal cells; centriole presence
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 lists centrioles as animal-cell organelles and counts 10 organelles. Lesson 4 lists only small vacuoles, nucleus, mitochondria, cytoplasm and membrane for animal cells, with no centrioles or other organelles. Lessons 7 and 8 say animal cells 'may contain' centrioles.

conflicts.fact: Nucleus shape of the white blood cell
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 and the anchoring phenomenon describe a large, visible nucleus. Lesson 8 describes a large lobed nucleus, an irregular shape, and many lysosomes.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson explains the absence of green colour in onion cells / chloroplast location
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 says the absence of green in onion will be explained in Lesson 4 when students study chloroplasts and where in a plant they are found. Lesson 4 never addresses the onion or where chloroplasts are found; it only covers sukuma wiki and a bean seedling.

conflicts.fact: Whether students had slides on benches / model-building lesson span
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 says the diagram will be refined across Lessons 5–8, but also across 'the next four lessons'. Lesson 2 says the model is refined through Lessons 3 to 7 until the final 3D model in Lesson 7. Lesson 8 says the 3D model was Lesson 7 and uses a conceptual map instead.
